items.title: Spring arts showcase — tickets
items.excerpt: Music, theater, and visual arts. Early-bird pricing ends April 5.
items.body:
Our annual Spring Arts Showcase brings together music, theater, dance, and visual arts from students across all grades.

Early-bird tickets are available at the school office until April 5. Evening shows run April 12–14 in the auditorium.
